description:
What this is. A shift says when the working day starts and ends, and how much grace there is either side. Attendance is worked out by comparing an employee's scans against their shift, so a wrong shift makes good attendance look bad.

What to do. Create one for each pattern you run — day, night, and so on — with its start and end time.

Where to find it. Shift Type, under HR.
name: Create a Shift
title: Shift Type — the working day
